name.ja: BANDAI SPIRITS パーツセパレーター

description.ja: 入門者にオススメ！組み立ての順番を間違えても大丈夫！BANDAI SPIRITS公式の「パーツセパレーター」が登場！
description.en: Recommended for beginners! It's okay if the assembly order is wrong! BANDAI SPIRITS official "parts separator" is now available!

description.ja: • プラモデルメーカーのノウハウを結集。手に馴染み、使い勝手の良い形状を実現。
description.en: • Bringing together the know-how of plastic model manufacturers. It has a shape that fits comfortably in your hand and is easy to use.

description.ja: • 樹脂成形だからパーツを傷つけずに分解できる。
description.en: • Because it is resin molded, it can be disassembled without damaging the parts.

description.ja: • ピンを差し込んで押し出すことでもパーツの分割が可能。
description.en: • Parts can also be separated by inserting and pushing out pins.

description.ja: • ポリキャップにピンを差し込めば、挟み込む際につぶれにくい。
description.en: • If you insert a pin into the polycap, it won't get crushed when you pinch it.
